terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
By purchasing an album through HTs Collections, you agree to these purchase terms.

Digital delivery

Albums are supplied as ZIP files containing MP3 audio tracks. After successful payment through Yoco, a download link is sent to the email address entered at checkout. The link expires 24 hours after issue, so download the file in time and keep your downloaded copy safe.

Licence and copyright

Your purchase grants you a personal-use licence to listen to the purchased music. Copyright and other intellectual-property rights remain with their respective owners. Unless you have separate written permission, you may not resell, redistribute, publicly share, upload, or commercially exploit the files or claim the music as your own.

Payments and technical requirements

Payments are processed through Yoco. You need a compatible device, software capable of extracting ZIP files and playing MP3 audio, and an internet connection to download your purchase. If payment is deducted but your order or link is missing, retain your payment confirmation and contact support.

These terms do not remove any rights you may have under applicable consumer-protection law.

refund-policy.title: Refund Policy
refund-policy.body:
HTs Collections aims to ensure that every paid album can be downloaded successfully.

  • Payment succeeded but no link arrived: check your spam/junk folder and retain your payment confirmation. Contact support so delivery can be investigated.
  • Broken or incomplete ZIP: contact support with your purchase details so we can investigate and help resolve the problem.
  • Duplicate or incorrect charge: provide the payment confirmation so the transaction can be checked.
  • Expired link: links expire 24 hours after issue. Contact support if a technical or delivery problem prevented downloading.

Refund requests are assessed individually and handled in accordance with applicable South African consumer-protection law. Nothing in this policy limits rights that cannot legally be excluded. A refund is not automatically guaranteed simply because a link expired after successful delivery, but genuine delivery or product faults will be considered.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.body:
HTs Collections aims to collect as little customer information as practical. The email address entered at checkout is used to send the album download link and, where needed, information about that purchase or a support request.

Payments are handled by Yoco. Payment processing may involve information provided directly to Yoco; HTs Collections does not ask you to send card details by email. Please review Yoco’s privacy information for details about its processing.

Purchase-related information may be used for delivery, payment/order verification, customer support, and applicable legal or accounting obligations. We do not sell your email address.

The download link expires 24 hours after it is issued. This does not necessarily mean related purchase records or emails are deleted at that time; records may be retained where reasonably necessary for support, security or legal obligations.

For privacy questions or requests concerning your information, reply to the email relating to your purchase and identify the order without sending payment-card details.
